concerns.text: FR-010 (dataset split into training and hold‑out validation sets, plus k‑fold cross‑validation) is not directly covered by any concrete task. The plan references a deferred split (Phase 5) and later tasks (T008‑T009) assume the split exists, but there is no explicit task that creates, records, and verifies the split indices. Add a task (e.g., T016) that performs the random‑seeded train/validation split, persists the index files, and validates the split size.
